name: za.co.getaccounted/sa-tax
title: GetAccountED
description: South African accounting and tax: SARS PAYE/VAT tools, plus your GetAccountED books after sign-in

tools.name: sa_paye_calculate
tools.description: Employees' tax (PAYE), UIF (employee and employer, with the monthly ceiling), SDL and net pay for one South African employee and pay period, using the SARS tax deduction tables (or the exact statutory-rates formula) for the right tax year. Handles age rebates, the medical scheme fees tax credit, retirement-fund deductions (s11F cap), travel allowance (80%/20%), bonuses (annual-payment method), commission and fringe benefits.

salary.description: Basic salary/wage for the pay period, in rand (before deductions)

period.description: What the amounts are per (default monthly). Non-monthly amounts are converted to a monthly equivalent.

pay_date.description: Pay date / period end, YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Decides the tax year: March onwards → next year (2026-11-30 → 2027 tax year).

tax_year.description: Tax year instead of pay_date, e.g. "2027" (1 March 2026 – 28 February 2027)

age.description: Age on the last day of the tax year (65+ and 75+ get extra rebates). Or give date_of_birth / id_number.

id_number.description: SA ID number (only used to read the date of birth; not stored)

medical_aid_members.description: People on the medical aid including the employee (for the s6A tax credit)

medical_aid_contribution.description: Employee's own medical aid contribution deducted from pay (source code 4005)

employer_medical_aid.description: Medical aid paid by the employer for the employee (fringe benefit 3810)

travel_allowance.description: Travel allowance (3701): 80% taxed through PAYE, or 20% if at least 80% business use

travel_business_80.description: True when the employer is satisfied the vehicle is used at least 80% for business

bonus.description: Bonus / annual payment paid in this period (3605), taxed by the SARS annual-payment method

taxable_allowance.description: Other taxable allowance — cell phone, housing, tools (3713)

other_deductions.description: Other non-tax deductions from net pay (loans, union fees…)

method.description: tables = SARS monthly tax deduction tables (default); formula = exact statutory-rates calculation

tools.name: sa_vat_calculate
tools.description: Split a VAT-inclusive amount into VAT and the exclusive price, or add VAT to an exclusive amount, at the South African VAT rate in force on the date (15% since 1 April 2018). One amount or a list of lines, with per-line and total figures.

inclusive.description: true = amount(s) include VAT (default); false = amount(s) exclude VAT

description.description: What the line is (shown back in the result)

amount.description: Amount in rand for one unit

inclusive.description: true = this line includes VAT; default is the top-level inclusive setting

date.description: Supply date YYYY-MM-DD (default today) — picks the rate from the rate history

tools.name: sa_vat_classify
tools.description: Is a supply standard-rated, zero-rated or exempt under the South African VAT Act, and can the buyer claim the input VAT (s17(2): entertainment, club subscriptions, motor cars…)? Answers from a curated rules table with the VAT Act section for each rule, plus related official material from the GetLawED library. Says plainly when no rule matches.

description.description: What is being sold or bought, in plain words (e.g. "client lunch at a restaurant", "brown bread", "double cab bakkie")

side.description: sale = output VAT treatment; purchase = can input VAT be claimed; both (default)

include_library.description: Also search the GetLawED library for related official material (default true)

tools.name: sa_tax_calendar
tools.description: SARS (and CIPC) due dates in a date range: EMP201 (7th, earlier when that is a weekend or public holiday), VAT201 by VAT category A–E (eFiling: last business day of the month after the period), provisional tax IRP6, EMP501 reconciliation windows, ITR14 and CIPC annual returns. Uses South African public holidays.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default 3 months after from; at most 2 years)

vat_category.description: VAT category: A = 2-monthly ending odd months, B = 2-monthly ending even months, C = monthly, D = 6-monthly, E = annual; none (default) = not VAT registered

vat_period_end_month.description: Category D/E only: month (1-12) a period ends

year_end_month.description: Financial year-end month 1-12 (default 2 = February, the individual tax year)

incorporation_date.description: Companies/CCs: YYYY-MM-DD, for the CIPC annual return

tools.name: sa_validate_reference
tools.description: Format and check-digit checks for South African numbers: ID number (Luhn check digit, date of birth, gender, citizenship), income tax reference, VAT number (10 digits starting with 4), PAYE/SDL/UIF employer references and CIPC company registration numbers. Offline checks only — they do not confirm the number is registered.

tools.name: sa_tax_rates
tools.description: Individual income tax brackets, rebates, tax thresholds, medical scheme fees tax credits, retirement deduction cap, UIF rate and ceiling, SDL rate and exemption threshold, and the VAT rate — for a tax year (current and prior years), from the tables GetAccountED payroll uses.

tax_year.description: e.g. "2027" = 1 March 2026 – 28 February 2027 (default: current tax year)

compare_previous.description: Also show the previous tax year (default false)

tools.name: accounting_list_my_businesses
tools.description: Lists the GetAccountED books this sign-in can work on, with their business_id. Use it first when the user is an accounting practice and asks about a particular client, then pass that business_id to the other accounting_ tools. For a single business it simply confirms which books are connected. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

tools.name: accounting_overview
tools.description: Snapshot of the business's books for a period: income, expenses and profit (from the ledger), bank balances, money owed by customers and to suppliers, VAT position, bank lines still to reconcile and slips still missing. Defaults to this month so far. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: first day of this month)

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Profit and loss for a period, per account (income and expense accounts, from the general ledger). Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_balance_sheet
tools.description: Balance sheet as at a date: assets, liabilities and equity per account, including profit to date not yet closed off. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_list_invoices
tools.description: Customer invoices. status: open (unpaid or part-paid), overdue, paid, or all. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_list_expenses
tools.description: Expenses and supplier bills recorded in a period, with account, VAT, payment status and whether a slip is attached. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_reconciliation_status
tools.description: Bank reconciliation status per uploaded statement, plus the bank payments that still need a slip or invoice. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_submit_document
tools.description: Only when you hold the actual file bytes (e.g. read from disk in code): hand in a receipt, till slip, fuel slip or supplier invoice (PDF or photo, base64, max 10 MB). For a slip the user showed you in the chat use accounting_record_slip instead. It is read immediately and filed under Slips & Documents for the business to check and post — nothing is posted to the ledger by this tool. Returns what was read. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_record_slip
tools.description: Hand in a receipt, till slip, fuel slip or supplier invoice that the user showed you (photo or PDF in the chat): read it yourself and send the details printed on it. It is filed under Slips & Documents for the business to check and post — nothing is posted to the ledger. The reply contains a one-time upload link: give it to the user so they can attach the original slip (needed for a VAT claim). Only send what is printed; leave out anything you cannot read. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

total.description: Total amount paid or owed, VAT included, in rand

vat_amount.description: VAT amount printed on the slip (omit if none is printed)

supplier_vat_number.description: Supplier VAT number if printed (10 digits starting with 4)

payment_method.description: card, cash, eft or account, if printed

note.description: What it was for, in the user's words (e.g. "client lunch", "office printer ink")

account_code.description: Expense account code from accounting_chart_of_accounts, only if the user chose one

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_slip_upload_link
tools.description: A new one-time upload link for a slip handed in with accounting_record_slip whose original has not been attached yet (e.g. the first link expired). Give the link to the user. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_chart_of_accounts
tools.description: The business's chart of accounts (code, name, type). Use the codes when filing a bank line to an account. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_unfiled_bank_lines
tools.description: Bank statement lines still waiting to be filed, each with its line_id, the suggestion GetAccountED made (account, invoice or rule) and candidate open items: unpaid customer invoices (money in) or unpaid supplier bills (money out) matching by amount or name. Amounts in rand. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

from.description: Only lines on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

to.description: Only lines on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

direction.description: Money in, money out or all (default all)

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_file_bank_line
tools.description: File one unfiled bank line. Give ONE of: account_code (e.g. bank charges, income, a loan), invoice allocations / customer_id (customer receipt — remainder goes on account), bill allocations / supplier_id or supplier_name (supplier payment), or on_account:true with a customer or supplier. TWO STEPS: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview of the journal it will post plus a confirm_token; call again with exactly the same arguments plus confirm_token (valid 10 minutes, single use) to post it. Always show the user the preview and get their OK first. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

account_code.description: File straight to this account (chart of accounts code)

vat.description: With account_code: split 15% VAT out of the amount (VAT vendors only). Omit to use the default for that account.

refund.description: With account_code: money in that is a refund of an expense

allocations.description: Which invoices (money in) or bills (money out) this pays, with optional amounts (part payments allowed). Omit amount to settle as much as is due, in order.

amount.description: Rand allocated to this invoice or bill

customer_id.description: Customer id (inv client) — for a receipt; anything not allocated goes on account

supplier_id.description: Supplier contact id — for a supplier payment

supplier_name.description: Supplier known only by name on its bills

on_account.description: Whole amount on account with the customer / supplier

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_refile_bank_line
tools.description: Re-file a bank line that was already filed wrongly: reverses everything it posted (one reversal journal on the line's date, payments taken back off invoices/bills) and files it again to the new target. Same target arguments as accounting_file_bank_line. TWO STEPS: first call = preview of the reversal and new journal + confirm_token; second call with confirm_token does it. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

account_code.description: New target: file straight to this account (chart of accounts code)

vat.description: With account_code: split 15% VAT out of the amount (VAT vendors only). Omit to use the default for that account.

refund.description: With account_code: money in that is a refund of an expense

allocations.description: New target: which invoices (money in) or bills (money out) this pays, with optional amounts (part payments allowed). Omit amount to settle as much as is due, in order.

amount.description: Rand allocated to this invoice or bill

customer_id.description: New target: customer id — for a receipt; anything not allocated goes on account

supplier_id.description: New target: supplier contact id — for a supplier payment

supplier_name.description: New target: supplier known only by name on its bills

on_account.description: Whole amount on account with the customer / supplier

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_create_invoice_draft
tools.description: Create a DRAFT customer invoice (never sent, not in the ledger until the business sends it from GetAccountED). VAT at 15% if the business is a VAT vendor. TWO STEPS: first call returns the totals + confirm_token; second call with confirm_token saves the draft. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

customer_name.description: Or the customer's name (must match one customer)

create_customer.description: Create the customer by customer_name if none matches

description.description: What is being invoiced on this line

vat_category.description: VAT treatment of this line (default standard)

prices_include_vat.description: true = unit prices already include VAT; false = VAT added on top. Default: the business's invoice setting.

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_list_customers
tools.description: List or search the business's customers with their contact details (email, phone, address, VAT and registration number), account number and what they owe. Use it before adding or updating customers. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

query.description: Words to match in the name, company, account number or email

missing.description: Only customers with this detail missing

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_update_customers
tools.description: Add customers, or fill in MISSING details of existing customers (matched by customer_id, account number or exact name). Nothing already recorded is overwritten. TWO STEPS: first call = preview + confirm_token; the change is only made on the second call with confirm_token. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

name.description: Customer name (a new customer is added when no existing one matches and add_if_new is true)

add_if_new.description: Add customers that do not exist yet (default false)

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_aged_debtors
tools.description: Aged debtors (who owes the business, by age: not yet due, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-120, 120+ days past due) as at a date, reconciled to Accounts Receivable. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

basis.description: Age from due date (default) or invoice date

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_aged_creditors
tools.description: Aged creditors (what the business owes suppliers, by age) as at a date, reconciled to Accounts Payable. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

basis.description: Age from due date (default) or invoice date

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_debtor_reminder
tools.description: Drafts a polite payment-reminder email (text only — nothing is sent) for each customer with overdue invoices, listing the invoices and amounts. Edit it, then the business sends it — or use accounting_send_invoice_reminder to send GetAccountED's standard branded reminder for one invoice. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

min_days_overdue.description: Only invoices at least this many days overdue (default 1)

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_send_invoice_reminder
tools.description: Email GetAccountED's standard branded payment reminder (with pay-online link and the invoice PDF) for one unpaid invoice to the customer's email on file. TWO STEPS: first call shows who it goes to + confirm_token; the email is only sent on the second call with confirm_token. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

invoice_number.description: The invoice to remind the customer about (from accounting_list_invoices)

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_vat201_draft
tools.description: DRAFT VAT201 for a VAT period, field by field as on SARS eFiling (output tax, input tax, payable/refundable). A preparation draft — check it before filing on eFiling; nothing is submitted to SARS. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_emp201_detail
tools.description: EMP201 for a month from finalised pay runs: PAYE, UIF, SDL, ETI and total due to SARS (due the 7th of the next month), with per-employee lines. ID and tax numbers are masked. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_trial_balance
tools.description: Trial balance as at a date: every account's debit or credit balance and whether the ledger balances. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

tools.name: accounting_general_ledger
tools.description: General ledger for one account over a date range: opening balance, every posting with reference and description, running and closing balance. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.
